answer: A newcomer proves prior good standing with a zero-knowledge proof linking its new pseudonym to an earlier record of completed, audited work, without revealing that older identity. Trust is not a velvet shortcut: it grows through a karst landscape of slow, verified passages, and an unproven identity stays on the low spiral of small, closely checked jobs. A Sybil operator gains nothing by minting fresh names, since each one must either present a real earned proof or restart the climb from zero, and forged proofs fail verification and forfeit its bond.
